title: tillandsia guatemalensis
intro: Tillandsia guatemalensis, commonly known as the Guatemalan airplant or Guatemalan tillandsia, is a species of epiphytic flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. This air-purifying plant is known for its ability to thrive in humid environments without soil, making it a popular choice for indoor spaces. The health benefits of Tillandsia guatemalensis include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve air quality, and promote a sense of well-being. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
